text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/merge_duplicates.py (P1): it loads all households with load_households(active_only=False), finds duplicate groups via registry.dedup.find_duplicates, keeps the first record in each group whose ID passes is_valid_household_id (leaving groups with no valid ID untouched), and marks every other record in the group as \"merged\" with merged_into set via registry.register.set_status — no records deleted, no other fields changed. Ran it once (P2); it merged 6 duplicate pairs. Also added scripts/verify_merge.py and ran it: 58 records total, 49 active, 6 merged; every merged record points at an active kept record with a valid household ID, no duplicate families remain among active records, and nothing was deleted.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
